headlines.title: שר הביטחון כ"ץ : "אם ייחטף ישראלי אחד - העיר עזה תפונה ממיליון תושביה"
headlines.snippet: Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant warned Hamas that if a single Israeli is abducted, the city of Gaza, with its million residents, will be evacuated. The United States issued a travel warning for the Middle East, citing fears of rapid military escalation. Reports from the Emirates suggest that Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed did not warn of the October 7th events in his conversation with Netanyahu.
headlines.title_he: שר הביטחון כ"ץ : "אם ייחטף ישראלי אחד - העיר עזה תפונה ממיליון תושביה"

headlines.title: א-שרע בניו יורק: מבין את מה שקרה ב-7.10, לא הגיוני שזה יכתיב את המדיניות כלפי סוריה
headlines.snippet: Syrian President Bashar al-Assad stated in New York that while he understands the events of October 7th, they should not dictate policy towards Syria. Speaking at an event hosted by the Atlantic Council, he argued that Israel's security policies create problems for its neighbors and are ineffective. He also revealed that the two countries were close to a diplomatic settlement in the past, but Israel withdrew.
headlines.title_he: א-שרע בניו יורק: מבין את מה שקרה ב-7.10, לא הגיוני שזה יכתיב את המדיניות כלפי סוריה

headlines.title: מקרון בעצרת האו"ם: "בשם מה ההפרות בגדה המערבית? חמאס מעולם לא פעל שם"
headlines.snippet: French President Emmanuel Macron questioned violations in the West Bank during his address at the UN General Assembly, stating that Hamas has never operated there. He also emphasized the need to respect the Palestinian people's right to exist. Netanyahu responded by calling Macron's remarks 'unthinkable absurdity,' citing a recent French citizen's death by a Hamas member in the West Bank.

Concurrently, the United States issued a travel warning for the Middle East due to concerns about a rapid military escalation. headlines.title: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"
headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Yoav Gallant has warned Hamas that if any Israeli soldier or citizen is abducted, the entire city of Gaza will be evacuated. Speaking at a memorial ceremony, Gallant asserted that Israel would not compromise on its stance in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the Strip is demilitarized. He also addressed the campaign against Iran, stating that Iran's leader had been eliminated and the threat of nuclear annihilation removed.
headlines.title_he: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"

headlines.title: נשיא סוריה לברק רביד: "מבין את מה שקרה ב-7 באוקטובר לחפים מפשע, אך לא ייתכן שזה יקבע את המדיניות כלפינו"
headlines.snippet: Syrian President Bashar al-Assad expressed his understanding of the events of October 7th and the suffering of innocent people, but stated that these events should not define policy towards Syria. He recounted that negotiations with Israel nearly reached a 90% agreement, but Israel ultimately backed down. Al-Assad reiterated that the Golan is Syrian territory under UN recognition.
headlines.title_he: נשיא סוריה לברק רביד: "מבין את מה שקרה ב-7 באוקטובר לחפים מפשע, אך לא ייתכן שזה יקבע את המדיניות כלפינו"

headlines.title: 1 , Iran calls Trump ‘annihilation’ threat a sign of ‘strategic desperation’
headlines.snippet: Iran's response to Trump's threat to 'annihilate' it has been described as a sign of 'strategic desperation,' according to Tehran. They argue that the latest threats from the US president demonstrate America's 'strategic dead end' in the nearly seven-month war.

headlines.title: 2 , US, Iran hold mediated UNGA talks on ending war, opening Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: The United States and Iran held mediated talks at the UN General Assembly aimed at ending the war and opening the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran linked diplomatic progress to the lifting of shipping blockades and the unfreezing of assets during negotiations in New York.

headlines.title: 3 , France rebukes world over Gaza as Canada, UK back Palestinian state at UNGA
headlines.snippet: France has criticized the world over the situation in Gaza, while Canada and the UK have supported a Palestinian state at the UN General Assembly. French President Macron stated that the suffering in Gaza should 'shame all of us,' and Canada's Carney pledged $71 million for two-state initiatives.

headlines.title: 4 , Zelenskyy says Ukraine ready for energy truce with Russia after Trump talks
headlines.snippet: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy announced that Ukraine is ready for an energy truce with Russia, provided Moscow halts attacks on its energy system. This statement followed talks with Trump.

headlines.title: 5 , Iran war updates: Witkoff, Iran’s FM Araghchi meet in New York
headlines.snippet: Updates on the Iran war indicate that Witkoff and Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi met in New York. These were the updates on the US-Iran war as of Tuesday, September 22, 2026.

headlines.snippet: Turkish Airlines has suspended all flights to Iran until at least March 2027. This decision follows a US Treasury warning about a worldwide shutdown of Iranian carriers, with Iraq also halting Iranian flights.

headlines.title: Erdogan calls for UN Security Council reform, urges abolition of veto power
headlines.snippet: President Erdogan called for reform of the UN Security Council and urged the abolition of veto power, according to trtworld.com.
